action: Call Rick Tanner directly and give him an answer on the contract extension request. Offer a 60-day extension at the same $4,500 per month rate — not 90, not indefinite — with a defined deliverable attached: a written transition advisory summary covering the three-location operational model, EV certification status, and recommendations for the next two quarters. The extension is not charity and it is not open-ended. It is a bounded engagement with a concrete output that I can use when Rick eventually exits to work with other clients or seek other employment. He is already having those conversations. I know it. I am not threatened by it. I am pricing it correctly.
